{{- if eq site.Language.Lang "da" }}{{ $intro = $intro | append "Alt indhold er på dansk." }}{{ end -}}
{{- with $intro }}{{ delimit . " " }}
{{ end }}{{ range site.Sections }}

{{ end }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
{{- $andre := slice -}}
{{- range where site.Pages "Kind" "section" -}}
  {{- if not .RegularPagesRecursive }}{{ $andre = $andre | append . }}{{ end -}}

{{- with site.GetPage "/tags" }}{{ $andre = $andre | append . }}{{ end }}
